import {createHash,randomBytes} from 'node:crypto';import {open,realpath,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';import {constants} from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import {fileURLToPath,pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
export const AUDIO_SCRIPT_SHA256='42f48103b327c63bdb7a22f7cfb8fe9c57010014e468ed7cda5a557cfc1d2e17';
export const AUDIO_RCC_SHA256='dd8a9efebe9b09a4b5e84e5c768ad7c7a38ea9702e681a357898dcbb9674ce01';
const nativeHelper=await readSmall(fileURLToPath(new URL('./native-browser-capture.js',import.meta.url)));
async function readSmall(filename){const f=await open(filename,constants.O_RDONLY|constants.O_NOFOLLOW|constants.O_NONBLOCK);try{const st=await f.stat();if(!st.isFile()||st.size>65536)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio source');const b=Buffer.alloc(65537);let n=0;while(n<b.length){const r=await f.read(b,n,b.length-n,n);if(!r.bytesRead)break;n+=r.bytesRead;}if(n>65536)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio source');return b.subarray(0,n).toString();}finally{await f.close();}}
async function verifyResources(filename){const f=await open(filename,constants.O_RDONLY|constants.O_NOFOLLOW|constants.O_NONBLOCK);try{const st=await f.stat();if(!st.isFile()||st.size!==141862855)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio resource bundle');const b=Buffer.alloc(65536),hash=createHash('sha256');let n=0;while(n<=st.size){const r=await f.read(b,0,Math.min(b.length,st.size-n),n);if(!r.bytesRead)break;n+=r.bytesRead;hash.update(b.subarray(0,r.bytesRead));}if(n!==st.size||(await f.stat()).size!==st.size||hash.digest('hex')!==AUDIO_RCC_SHA256)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio resource bundle');}finally{await f.close();}}
const once=(s,a,b)=>{if(s.split(a).length!==2)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio source');return s.replace(a,b);};
export function buildBrowserCaptureUI(source,channel,qmlURL){
 if(createHash('sha256').update(source).digest('hex')!==AUDIO_SCRIPT_SHA256||!/^overte\.browser\.capture\.[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(channel))throw Error('Unsupported native Audio source');
 const url=new URL(qmlURL);if(url.protocol!=='file:'||url.host||url.search||url.hash||path.basename(fileURLToPath(url))!=='browser-audio.qml')throw Error('Invalid private Audio UI path');
 let script=once(source,'var AUDIO_QML_SOURCE = "hifi/audio/Audio.qml";','var AUDIO_QML_SOURCE = '+JSON.stringify(url.href)+';\n'+`var browserCaptureChannel=${JSON.stringify(channel)},browserCaptureSequence=0,browserCaptureEpoch=0,browserCaptureActive=false;
function browserCaptureStateValid(s){if(!s||s.version!==1||typeof s.active!=='boolean'||Object.keys(s).length!==4||!s.controls||Object.keys(s.controls).length!==4||!s.settings||Object.keys(s.settings).length!==5)return false;var fields=['echoCancellation','noiseSuppression','autoGainControl','inputGainPercent'];for(var i=0;i<fields.length;i++){var f=fields[i],v=s.settings[f];if(typeof s.controls[f]!=='boolean'||(s.controls[f]&&v===null)||(v!==null&&(f==='inputGainPercent'?typeof v!=='number'||v%1!==0||v<0||v>200:typeof v!=='boolean'))||(!s.active&&(s.controls[f]||v!==null)))return false;}var gain=s.settings.inputGain;return(!s.controls.inputGainPercent||gain!==null)&&(gain===null||typeof gain==='number'&&isFinite(gain)&&gain>=0&&gain<=2&&s.settings.inputGainPercent===Math.round(gain*100))&&(s.active||gain===null);}
function browserCaptureMessage(channel,text,sender,localOnly){if(channel!==browserCaptureChannel||!localOnly||typeof text!=='string'||text.length>4096)return;var m;try{m=JSON.parse(text);}catch(e){return;}if(!m||typeof m.epoch!=='number'||m.epoch%1!==0||m.epoch<1||m.epoch>2147483647)return;if(m.kind==='scope'){if(m.epoch<browserCaptureEpoch||typeof m.active!=='boolean')return;browserCaptureEpoch=m.epoch;browserCaptureActive=m.active;if(onAudioScreen)tablet.sendToQml({type:'browserCaptureScope',epoch:m.epoch,active:m.active});return;}if(!onAudioScreen||m.epoch!==browserCaptureEpoch||m.kind!=='effective'||typeof m.sequence!=='number'||m.sequence%1!==0||m.sequence<=browserCaptureSequence||m.sequence>9007199254740991||typeof m.ready!=='boolean'||!browserCaptureStateValid(m.state)||['ok','inactive','unsupported','busy','apply-refused','readback-mismatch','rollback-refused','deadline','cancelled'].indexOf(m.reason)<0)return;browserCaptureSequence=m.sequence;tablet.sendToQml({type:'browserCaptureState',epoch:m.epoch,ready:m.ready,state:m.state,reason:m.reason});}
function browserCaptureFromQml(m){if(!onAudioScreen||!m||typeof m!=='object')return;if(m.type==='browserCaptureReady'&&m.epoch===0){if(browserCaptureEpoch>0)tablet.sendToQml({type:'browserCaptureScope',epoch:browserCaptureEpoch,active:browserCaptureActive});return;}if(!browserCaptureActive||m.epoch!==browserCaptureEpoch||browserCaptureEpoch<1)return;if(m.type==='browserCaptureReady')Messages.sendLocalMessage(browserCaptureChannel,JSON.stringify({kind:'ready',epoch:m.epoch}));else if(m.type==='browserCaptureChange')Messages.sendLocalMessage(browserCaptureChannel,JSON.stringify({kind:'change',epoch:m.epoch,field:m.field,value:m.value}));}`);
 script=once(script,'    button.editProperties({isActive: onAudioScreen});','    button.editProperties({isActive: onAudioScreen});\n    if(onAudioScreen&&browserCaptureEpoch>0){tablet.sendToQml({type:"browserCaptureScope",epoch:browserCaptureEpoch,active:browserCaptureActive});Messages.sendLocalMessage(browserCaptureChannel,JSON.stringify({kind:"ready",epoch:browserCaptureEpoch}));}');
 script=once(script,'onMuteToggled();\n','onMuteToggled();\nMessages.subscribe(browserCaptureChannel);Messages.messageReceived.connect(browserCaptureMessage);tablet.fromQml.connect(browserCaptureFromQml);\n');
 script=once(script,'    tablet.removeButton(button);','    tablet.fromQml.disconnect(browserCaptureFromQml);Messages.messageReceived.disconnect(browserCaptureMessage);Messages.unsubscribe(browserCaptureChannel);\n    tablet.removeButton(button);');
 const qml=`// Copyright 2026 Overte contributors
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
// Genuine installed native Audio page plus explicitly browser-owned capture controls.
import QtQuick 2.15
import QtQuick.Controls 2.15
import QtQuick.Layouts 1.3
import stylesUit 1.0
import controlsUit 1.0 as HifiControlsUit
Rectangle {
 id: root; color: '#252525'; property var browserState: ({version:1,active:false,controls:{echoCancellation:false,noiseSuppression:false,autoGainControl:false,inputGainPercent:false},settings:{echoCancellation:null,noiseSuppression:null,autoGainControl:null,inputGainPercent:null,inputGain:null}});
 property int browserUiEpoch:0;property bool browserReady:false;property string browserReason:'inactive';property bool awaiting:false;
 signal sendToScript(var message);
 function restoreControls(){echoControl.checked=Qt.binding(function(){return root.browserState.settings.echoCancellation===true;});noiseControl.checked=Qt.binding(function(){return root.browserState.settings.noiseSuppression===true;});agcControl.checked=Qt.binding(function(){return root.browserState.settings.autoGainControl===true;});gainControl.value=Qt.binding(function(){return root.browserState.settings.inputGainPercent===null?100:root.browserState.settings.inputGainPercent;});}
 function fromScript(message){if(message&&message.type==='browserCaptureScope'&&typeof message.epoch==='number'&&message.epoch%1===0&&message.epoch>=browserUiEpoch&&message.epoch>=1&&message.epoch<=2147483647){browserReady=false;awaiting=false;browserUiEpoch=message.epoch;if(message.active&&tabs.currentIndex===1)sendToScript({type:'browserCaptureReady',epoch:browserUiEpoch});return;}if(message&&message.type==='browserCaptureState'&&message.epoch===browserUiEpoch){browserReady=false;browserState=message.state;browserReason=message.reason||'ok';awaiting=false;restoreControls();browserReady=message.ready===true;}}
 function change(field,value){if(tabs.currentIndex===1&&browserUiEpoch>0&&browserReady&&!awaiting&&browserState.active&&browserState.controls[field]===true&&browserState.settings[field]!==value){awaiting=true;sendToScript({type:'browserCaptureChange',epoch:browserUiEpoch,field:field,value:value});}}
 ColumnLayout {anchors.fill:parent;spacing:8;
  TabBar {id:tabs;Layout.fillWidth:true;TabButton{text:'Native connection'}TabButton{text:'Browser microphone'}onCurrentIndexChanged:if(currentIndex===1)root.sendToScript({type:'browserCaptureReady',epoch:root.browserUiEpoch});}
  StackLayout {currentIndex:tabs.currentIndex;Layout.fillWidth:true;Layout.fillHeight:true;
   Item {Loader{id:nativeAudio;anchors.fill:parent;source:'qrc:/qml/hifi/audio/Audio.qml';}Connections{target:nativeAudio.item;ignoreUnknownSignals:true;function onSendToScript(message){root.sendToScript(message);}}Text{anchors.centerIn:parent;visible:nativeAudio.status===Loader.Error;color:'white';text:'The installed native Audio page could not be loaded.'}}
   Flickable {clip:true;contentWidth:width;contentHeight:settingsColumn.height;Column{id:settingsColumn;width:parent.width;spacing:18;
    Text{width:parent.width;wrapMode:Text.Wrap;color:'white';font.pixelSize:18;text:'Browser microphone processing'}
    Text{width:parent.width;wrapMode:Text.Wrap;color:'#cccccc';text:!root.browserReady?'Waiting for browser readback…':!root.browserState.active?'Enable your microphone in the browser to inspect and change capture settings.':root.awaiting?'Applying capture settings…':root.browserReason!=='ok'?'The browser did not apply this change ('+root.browserReason+').':'These controls affect your local browser microphone. Native mixer gains and device choices are separate.'}
    HifiControlsUit.Switch {id:echoControl;width:switchWidth;height:44;switchWidth:40;labelTextOn:'Echo Cancellation';checked:root.browserState.settings.echoCancellation===true;enabled:root.browserReady&&!root.awaiting&&root.browserState.controls.echoCancellation;onCheckedChanged:root.change('echoCancellation',checked);}
    HifiControlsUit.Switch {id:noiseControl;width:switchWidth;height:44;switchWidth:40;labelTextOn:'Noise Suppression';checked:root.browserState.settings.noiseSuppression===true;enabled:root.browserReady&&!root.awaiting&&root.browserState.controls.noiseSuppression;onCheckedChanged:root.change('noiseSuppression',checked);}
    HifiControlsUit.Switch {id:agcControl;width:switchWidth;height:44;switchWidth:40;labelTextOn:'Automatic Gain Control';checked:root.browserState.settings.autoGainControl===true;enabled:root.browserReady&&!root.awaiting&&root.browserState.controls.autoGainControl;onCheckedChanged:root.change('autoGainControl',checked);}
    Text{color:'white';text:'Capture gain: '+(root.browserState.settings.inputGainPercent===null?'unavailable':root.browserState.settings.inputGainPercent+'%')}
    Slider{id:gainControl;width:parent.width;from:0;to:200;stepSize:1;value:root.browserState.settings.inputGainPercent===null?100:root.browserState.settings.inputGainPercent;enabled:root.browserReady&&!root.awaiting&&root.browserState.controls.inputGainPercent;onMoved:if(!pressed)root.change('inputGainPercent',Math.round(value));onPressedChanged:if(!pressed)root.change('inputGainPercent',Math.round(value));}
    Text{width:parent.width;wrapMode:Text.Wrap;color:'#cccccc';text:'Unsupported processing is disabled. Device labels stay in your browser; this page does not request microphone permission.'}
   }}
  }
 }
 Timer{interval:500;repeat:true;running:tabs.currentIndex===1&&!root.browserReady&&!root.awaiting;onTriggered:root.sendToScript({type:'browserCaptureReady',epoch:root.browserUiEpoch});}
}
`;
 return{script,qml};
}
export async function loadBrowserCapturePackage(defaultScriptsURL){
 const url=new URL(defaultScriptsURL);if(url.protocol!=='file:'||url.host||url.search||url.hash)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio path');const defaults=fileURLToPath(url);if(path.basename(defaults)!=='defaultScripts.js'||await realpath(defaults)!==defaults)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio path');
 const target=path.join(path.dirname(defaults),'system/audio.js'),rcc=path.join(path.dirname(path.dirname(defaults)),'resources.rcc');if(await realpath(target)!==target||await realpath(rcc)!==rcc)throw Error('Unsupported native Audio path');const source=await readSmall(target);await verifyResources(rcc);buildBrowserCaptureUI(source,'overte.browser.capture.'+'0'.repeat(32),'file:///tmp/browser-audio.qml');
 return {async prepare(directory){const channel='overte.browser.capture.'+randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),qmlPath=path.join(directory,'browser-audio.qml'),scriptPath=path.join(directory,'browser-audio.js'),helper=path.join(directory,'native-browser-capture.js'),generated=buildBrowserCaptureUI(source,channel,pathToFileURL(qmlPath).href);for(const [file,text]of [[qmlPath,generated.qml],[scriptPath,generated.script],[helper,nativeHelper]])await writeFile(file,text,{flag:'wx',mode:0o600});return{scriptURL:pathToFileURL(helper).href,channel,qmlURL:pathToFileURL(qmlPath).href,schemaVersion:1,readOnlyOverrides:[{source:scriptPath,target}]};}};
}
